DEFERRED_REMEDIATION (user-acknowledged, 2026-05-22):

The following items have been explicitly deferred to future work by the user. Each is tracked in a separate follow-up bug ticket. The `arch-evidence:remediation-partial` tag has been removed; this comment is the canonical record of the deferral.

1. **arch-evidence audit probe_5** (originally flagged 2026-05-16):
   - audit_source: docs/findings/architecture-vs-evidence-audit-2026-05-16.md
   - status: deferred (was: skipped — original rationale "epic has zero children" is now stale; the epic accumulated 14 stories + 25 tasks over the project lifecycle, all of which are now in terminal state)
   - no follow-up bug filed; the audit doc remains as the canonical reference if a future session wants to revisit the probe

2. **Phase 4 unresolvable IDs** — 12 of 118 brainstorm:complete-tagged epics lack a CLOSURE_CHECKS_CLASSIFIER_AUDIT comment because the classifier helper cannot process them:
   - 5 archived epics with empty descriptions: 8a5b-e07b, be38-5524, cd3c-2faa, d000-2598, e136-0ec7 (classifier errors with "could not read description" instead of writing an empty audit)
   - 7 alias-style IDs that ticket show rejects: dso-3xhk, dso-g10j, dso-gkct, dso-khl2, dso-t7af, dso-to7x, w21-bsnz (different from the adjective-noun-noun alias case fixed by bug 9894-a463-090a-43e5)
   - tracking bug: b92c-e358-1dcb-447a (P3, suggested ~5-line classifier fix for Class A; Class B depends on canonical-ID exposure in list-epics)

3. **5 CI llm-review findings on prior closed work** (PR #267 cycle 1, on closure-checks-classifier-pass.sh):
   - snapshot corruption risk, regex move-pattern brittleness, JSON load without UTF-8, hardcoded model ID, budget tracking divergence
   - status: deferred via user option B; PR #267 admin-merged at 2026-05-22T04:13:11Z (merge commit a02f35b8bc)
   - tracking bug: 33ad-1ab9-e46f-4888 (P3, all 5 findings with file:line citations and suggested fixes)

These deferrals do not block epic closure: SC1-SC10 evaluate the Closure Checks SCHEMA + tooling that ship in this epic; the deferred items are operational follow-ups against tooling already shipped, not unmet SC requirements.

Verifier dispatch will run next.
